content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the DTU Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Assistant-I: Bachelor’s degree in science with relevant subjects, or a 3-year Diploma in Engineering and Technology from a recognized institution

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DTU Project Assistant-I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: DTU Project Assistant-I Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Delhi Technological University (DTU) for hiring eligible candidates for contractual positions in Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post for this recruitment drive is Project Assistant-I under the science and engineering project category.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced for DTU Project Assistant-I?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Project Assistant-I post in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for DTU Project Assistant-I?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to attend the walk-in interview directly at the designated venue on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the DTU Project Assistant-I recruitment is scheduled to be held on 13 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for Project Assistant-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s degree in science with relevant subjects, or a 3-year Diploma in Engineering and Technology from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Assistant-I post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 27,000 plus applicable HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for DTU Project Assistant-I recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category, including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What are the selection stages for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily consists of a Walk-in Interview followed by document verification of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for selected candidates?
faq.answer: The job location for the appointed candidates will be in Delhi, specifically at Delhi Technological University premises with the pincode 110042.
